query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `userPointsLog` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `points` int NOT NULL,
  `activityType` enum('daily_challenge_correct','daily_challenge_streak','case_submission','case_approved','flashcard_session','flashcard_card_viewed','admin_adjustment') NOT NULL,
  `referenceId` int,
  `referenceType` varchar(64),
  `note` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `idx_upl_user` (`userId`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `userPointsTotals` (
  `userId` int PRIMARY KEY,
  `totalPoints` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `challengePoints` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `casePoints` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `flashcardPoints` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `accreditationChecklist` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `accreditationType` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `sectionKey` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `checked` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `idx_ac_user_type` (`userId`, `accreditationType`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `soundBytes` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `body` longtext,
  `videoUrl` text NOT NULL,
  `thumbnailUrl` text,
  `category` enum('acs','adult_echo','pediatric_echo','fetal_echo','pocus','physics','ecg') NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('draft','published') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `sortOrder` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `displayViews` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `createdByUserId` int,
  `publishedAt` timestamp NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `soundByteViews` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `soundByteId` int NOT NULL,
  `userId` int,
  `watchedSeconds` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `completed` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `idx_sbv_soundbyte` (`soundByteId`),
  INDEX `idx_sbv_user` (`userId`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `soundByteDiscussions` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `soundByteId` int NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `body` text NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('pending','approved','rejected') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `createdAt` bigint NOT NULL,
  `updatedAt` bigint NOT NULL,
  INDEX `idx_sbd_soundbyte` (`soundByteId`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `soundByteDiscussionReplies` (
  `id` varchar(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  `discussionId` int NOT NULL,
  `userId` int NOT NULL,
  `userName` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `body` text NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` bigint NOT NULL,
  INDEX `idx_sbdr_discussion` (`discussionId`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `abTestEvents` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `testId` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `variant` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `event` enum('impression','click') NOT NULL,
  `userId` int,
  `sessionId` varchar(64),
  `meta` text,
  `createdAt` bigint NOT NULL,
  INDEX `idx_abte_test` (`testId`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `menuLinkConfig` (
  `key` varchar(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  `url` text NOT NULL,
  `label` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `updatedByUserId` int,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `navigatorProtocolOverrides` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `module` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `sectionId` varchar(128) NOT NULL,
  `sectionTitle` varchar(256) NOT NULL,
  `probeNote` text,
  `items` text NOT NULL,
  `sortOrder` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `updatedByUserId` int,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `idx_npo_module` (`module`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mediaAccessRules` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `assetId` int NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(320) NOT NULL,
  `accessToken` varchar(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `grantedByUserId` int NOT NULL,
  `expiresAt` timestamp NULL,
  `revokedAt` timestamp NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `idx_mar_asset` (`assetId`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `mediaAccessLogs` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `assetId` int NOT NULL,
  `versionId` int,
  `accessType` enum('serve','embed') NOT NULL,
  `accessRuleId` int,
  `userId` int,
  `ipAddress` varchar(64),
  `userAgent` text,
  `referer` text,
  `accessedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  INDEX `idx_mal_asset` (`assetId`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `uploadJobs` (
  `id` varchar(64) PRIMARY KEY,
  `status` enum('pending','processing','done','error') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `resultUrl` text,
  `resultFileKey` text,
  `resultFileName` text,
  `resultMimeType` text,
  `resultSizeBytes` bigint,
  `errorMessage` text,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `educatorTemplates` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `uploadedByUserId` int NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(300) NOT NULL,
  `description` text,
  `ardmsCategory` enum('Adult Echo','Pediatric Echo','Fetal Echo','General Ultrasound','Vascular Ultrasound','General') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Adult Echo',
  `contentType` enum('presentation','quiz','flashcard_deck','case_study','protocol_guide','study_guide') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'presentation',
  `fileUrl` text,
  `fileKey` text,
  `mimeType` varchar(100),
  `slidesData` longtext,
  `contentData` longtext,
  `coverImageUrl` text,
  `tags` text,
  `estimatedMinutes` int,
  `viewCount` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `isPublished` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `isViewOnly` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
